descrizione: side-swept dark-brown hair with pointed locks, the big head about 45 % of his height on a short body, light tan skin, plain white T-shirt, deep-teal shorts, brick-red sneakers with cream soles
carattere: He is a cool, ironic grown-up man of about 25 drawn as a caricature (big head on a small body), never a child

mosse.cammina: WALK CYCLE, 4 frames: right foot forward contact, passing pose with the legs together, left foot forward contact, passing pose with the legs together, arms swinging opposite to the legs (frame 2 is also the standing pose)
mosse.scatto: DASH WITH A ROLL, 4 frames: crouched anticipation leaning back, explosive lunge forward stretched long and low, tucked into a ball rolling forward, landing back on his feet in a running pose
mosse.bevi: DRINKING A POTION, 4 frames: holding a small round glass potion bottle with glowing mint liquid at chest height, raising it to his mouth, drinking with the head tilted back, lowering it with a satisfied grin
